name: model-router
description: Classifies every prompt and runs it on the cheapest model and effort that can do it well: Haiku, Sonnet, Opus or Fable.

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: auto switches the model per prompt; suggest only shows the route in the status line; off does nothing.

tiebreaker.title: Tiebreaker
tiebreaker.description: When the keyword rules are unsure, ask Haiku for a one-word label (a few hundred tokens), or fall back to Sonnet.

designModel.title: Design tier model
designModel.description: Model for graphic design, layouts, brand assets and storyboards.

videoModel.title: Video tier model
videoModel.description: Model that writes prompts and drives Higgsfield (Seedance, Genjutsu). Rendering happens on Higgsfield either way.

cacheGuardTokens.title: Cache guard (tokens)
cacheGuardTokens.description: Past this context size the router will not drop to a cheaper model mid-conversation, since re-caching costs more than it saves. 0 disables the guard.
